provenance: vendor/Studio copy (older database): studio/src/data.js + data-ext.js, read-only

meta.population: every record in the public ISO-NE interconnection queue register, all three zone populations of the mart summed (bridged, suspect bus excluded, no bus match), every fuel and agreement state
meta.status_rule: the register's own status letter: A active, C in service or complete, W withdrawn — never a date rule
meta.entry_year: year(requested) — the year the request entered the queue
